fees.notes: Official IUKL (now KLUST) international fee schedule effective 26 Apr 2022, archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20220627135640id_/https://iukl.edu.my/iukl-application-forms/Undergraduate-International-fee-structure.pdf?v=20220513: tuition RM25,200 total for Diploma in Business Administration (2 years, RM280/credit); approximate all-in programme fee RM35,460. Current KLUST site (checked 2026-09-18) no longer publishes programme fees ('Ask us').

requirements.general: Any one of these: SPM: Minimum 3Cs. O-Level: Minimum 3Cs. UEC: Minimum 3Bs. Certificate / SKM III: A pass in SKM Level III and a pass in SPM with a minimum of 1 credit in any subject. SAM / HSC / AUSMAT: (Kindly refer to the Faculty) STPM: Pass STPM with a minimum C (GP 2.0) in any subject. STAM: Pass STAM with a minimum grade of Maqbul. CPU / CIMP: (Kindly refer to the Faculty). Other Qualifications: As recognised by the Senate of IUKL as equivalent to SPM. ENGLISH LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT (INTERNATIONAL): IELTS - 5 TOEFL (PBT) - 410 TOEFL (IBT) - 42 PTE - 47 MUET - BAND 3 Cambridge English - 154
